notes.title: Polimines 2 1.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
NEW: ¡Community Items are now available!

NEW: 3 levels unlocked per level completed (previously 1)

NEW: Option to change draw color

NEW: Listed old and new keyboard shortcuts in info menu

FIX: (Lots of) Minor improvements / bug fixes

notes.title: Polimines 2 1.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hotfix for some urgent and not-so-urgent issues:


 Fixed issues with some of the final levels.
 Clarified tutorials for two mid-late game mechanics.
 Improved edge cases when customizing colours.


Sorry to everyone who couldn't finish the game due to the issues on the final levels. I've triple checked everything now but please let me know if you find anything out of place.

Thanks again for your bug reports and suggestions!

notes.title: Polimines 2 1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Quick release day hotfix:


 New option to disable automatic "red boxes" around inside clues, giving you the option to hold left click to trigger them.
 UI is now fully enabled when in draw mode.
 Fixed mistakes on levels 32 and 47 (Thanks foxclear!)
 (Hopefully) Fixed bug where music plays on start, even if the game is muted. Let me know if you still encounter this bug, it's elusive.


Thanks everyone for your bug reports and suggestions!

notes.title: 📣 RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT! 📣
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

It's time to announce the release date for the full version of Polimines 2!

The game will officially release Wednesday, November 1st featuring:

 60 hand-crafted levels
 2 new mechanics not shown in the demo
 A beautiful jazz soundtrack to listen to while you play
 +10 hours of gameplay (possibly many more!)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43824684/22848e862f743f9c13fef6d600e90e4d411c39b8.png

I'm so excited for you to see what I've been working on!

notes.title: Working on the full release!
notes.notes:
Hey there! I've been working hard to implement all the feedback you've so kindly given me these past weeks. Special thanks to all the Discord members who have helped me so much!

I've been working in a new highlight feature for inside hints, check it out:
[previewyoutube=Bmkf-ivVZqA;full][/previewyoutube]

This should help alleviate situations where that sneaky corner tile messes up your calculations.

There's also a new mechanic! Can you guess what it means?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43824684/69a0f722d065300b7e8173cfed70c20dc457baa2.png

Development is going great and I'm exited to tell you more before the full release later this year.

In the meantime, you can check out the original Polimines if you haven't yet!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1892790/

Thank you for your support!
